definitions.explanation: A title for a buddha, one who has attained enlightenment; used in the names of buddhas such as {釈迦如来|しゃかにょらい} and {阿弥陀如来|あみだにょらい}. In temple statuary, the highest of the four ranks of figures.

examples.english: To pray before a statue of a buddha.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大仏|だいぶつ}→大仏：31679_daibutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{如来|にょらい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Great Buddha of Nara is one of the buddhas.

examples.japanese: {如来|にょらい}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧な⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まとい、⟦{菩薩|ぼさつ}→菩薩：33258_bosatsu⟧⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につけ→身につく：31476_minitsuku⟧て⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Buddha statues usually wear only a simple robe, without the ornaments of bodhisattva statues.

notes:
From Sanskrit tathāgata, "one who has thus come."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釈迦如来|しゃかにょらい}: Shakyamuni Buddha
- {阿弥陀如来|あみだにょらい}: Amida Buddha
- {薬師如来|やくしにょらい}: the Medicine Buddha
- {大日如来|だいにちにょらい}: the Cosmic Buddha of esoteric Buddhism

CULTURAL NOTE:
Temple statues fall into four ranks: {如来|にょらい} (buddhas), ⟦{菩薩|ぼさつ}→菩薩：33258_bosatsu⟧ (bodhisattvas), {明王|みょうおう} (wisdom kings) and ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧ (guardian deities). A {如来|にょらい} is shown in plain robes with tightly curled hair.
